proposals.evidence: Turner4269 gives Prakrit guṁchā moustache, Kashmiri gõch and Savi gōčē. Poguli gucʰe fits this regional g-initial moustache family; its unmarked nasalisation and u vowel are retained. The proposed connection with guccha cluster is uncertain, so no direct link to that broader bunch-word entry is substituted. Source image and reviewed import row checked; no source transcription or identity changes.
